thread:
Anna: Quick sync — Redwood x StratusCloud co-marketing. We're running a benchmark-led launch: blog post w/ results, joint webinar, and a marketplace listing follow. Goals: generate MQLs, show cost/latency wins, and route partner-qualified leads to Stratus SEs. Need owners + deadlines.

Jess: i'm happy to draft the webinar narrative + blog outline. Need the raw benchmark CSV and model/infra notes. can we get that by EOD Thu?

Oliver: I can own partner ops: marketplace listing checklist, asset format, and the Partner CTA. Will also coordinate demo VPC for Stratus. @Mike who's handling the inbound mapping?

Mike: I'll map leads into HubSpot. Proposed flow:
- webinar registrants -> lifecycle = "partner_webinar"
- QC by SDR team A, tag = stratus_partner
- routed to Stratus SEs via webhooks
I'll post the HS form field mapping tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

Samira: Product points — we should highlight:
- latency at 95th percentile
- $/1k tokens comparison in replication scenarios
- model compatibility notes (quantized vs fp16)
I'll drop suggested slide bullets.

Jess: For the webinar landing + CTA let's use this gating:
1) register (basic fields)
2) optional: request a Stratus demo (checkbox)
3) UTM params: source=partner, campaign=benchmarkQ1

Oliver: demo env ready but needs seed dataset + small sample prompt set. @Anna can you confirm dataset share?

Anna: Yes, uploading CSV + prompt deck to the partner bucket now. link: https://redwood.example/partners/stratus/benchmark-assets
Please keep internal-only.

Mike: HS field mapping draft:
```
form_fields: ["email","company","title","register_for_demo","utm_source","utm_campaign"]
workflow:
  - if register_for_demo == true -> tag: partner_demo -> webhook to stratus_se_queue
  - else -> tag: partner_webinar -> sdr_nurture_flow
```

Jess: timeline proposal:
- Draft blog + figures by Mon (5 days)
- Webinar dry run Wed
- Landing page + form live Fri
- Marketplace listing next week

Anna: I'll coordinate the calendar invites and own the landing page. Can everyone add availability for a 30 min kickoff? @here

Oliver: Added — prefer Tue morning.

Samira: noted. I'll assemble the benchmark slide deck and send review comments inline.

Mike: I'll set up the HS webhook and share test payloads.

Jess: ok — tagging assets needed: benchmark CSV, slide deck, 2-pager, screenshots, logos. dropping a quick checklist:
- [ ] CSV (Anna)
- [ ] Slide deck (Samira)
- [ ] Blog draft (Jess)
- [ ] Landing page (Anna)
- [ ] HS mapping + webhook (Mike)
- [ ] Marketplace assets (Oliver)

Anna: perfect. if no blockers i'll schedule the kickoff for Tue 10am. :rocket:

Oliver: LGTM. let's keep the partner loop tight.
